backgrounds.name: Salt Lantern Valley
backgrounds.description: A salt-lake village whose missing household names turn a protective ward into an instrument of exile.

backgrounds.name: The Valley Archive
backgrounds.description: Original household ledgers wait beside the edited copies. Warm lamplight reveals the conditions a clean register omitted.

backgrounds.name: The North Landing
backgrounds.description: Spring rain washes a public jetty. Beyond the crossing stone, a ferry route enters fog that keeps a passenger's memories.

npcs.name: Su Lan
npcs.description: The bell keeper has stopped ringing a ward that erases households. She remembers how her own certainty helped the injustice begin.

npcs.name: Wei Jin
npcs.description: A veteran ferryman keeps the disputed crossing open. He asks whose winter harvest will bear the cost of repairing a wrong boundary.

npcs.name: An Ru
npcs.description: An archivist preserves the original household ledger. Her seal identifies the evidence without asking the village to accept her conclusions.

monsters.name: The Reed Listener
monsters.description: A spirit beast shelters nineteen stolen names in paper nests, spending its own memories to protect strangers.
